meta.description: Check whether a phone number, UPI ID, account or website has been reported by someone else on this prototype.

title: Check a number, UPI ID or link
subtitle: Paste anything you were sent, a phone number, a UPI ID, an account number, or a link, and we'll tell you whether it has been reported here before.
label: What do you want to check?
help: We work out what kind of identifier it is. You don't need to choose.
scopeBody: This searches only the reports filed on this prototype. It is not the national Suspect Repository and it is not connected to cybercrime.gov.in. A clean result here means nobody has reported it on this site, it does not mean the number or link is safe.
foundBody: {count, plural, =1 {This has been reported once on this prototype.} other {This has been reported # times on this prototype.}}
foundAdvice: Treat anything from this contact with real suspicion. If you have already paid, call 1930 now.
notFoundBody: Nobody has reported this on this prototype. That is not the same as safe, most fraud is reported late or never, so a clean result tells you very little.
notFoundAdvice: Judge it on what it is asking you to do. Nobody legitimate needs your OTP, and no real officer arrests anyone over a video call.
reportInstead: Something happened to you? File a report instead.
